summary: The visual loop every other presentation card iterates in: the capture tool renders any scene at a chosen size after a chosen settle, refuses a black or uniform frame, and writes a thumbnail; tools/capture-scenes.sh and its PowerShell twin render every scene under scenes/review, scenes/world, scenes/battle and scenes/shell; a captures job in CI uploads the set; docs/verification/captures/ says how to look and carries the first set.

coordination.notes: Branched from origin/backend/b0-expedition-state at f5d26d1. .github/workflows/verify.yml is touched only by appending a new captures job; rust-and-content and godot-suites are not edited. No game/scripts, no scenes, no project.godot, no Rust, no content, no docs/SHIP_PLAN.md. The capture tool is extended in place rather than copied: one tool answers 'render this scene to a PNG' and every P lane calls it.
